title: NextScholar instructional composition rubric
purpose: Provide evidence-bounded formative feedback for a separately timed scholarship-preparation composition without claiming to reproduce an official scholarship marking scheme.

criteria.title: Task fulfilment and focus
criteria.description: How clearly and consistently the response addresses the stated topic, command and scope.

bands.label: Limited
bands.descriptor: The response has little relevant material or no controlling focus.

bands.label: Emerging
bands.descriptor: The response addresses part of the task but frequently drifts, generalises or leaves an important requirement unanswered.

bands.label: Developing
bands.descriptor: The response addresses the main task with a recognisable focus, although some material is thin, repetitive or only partly relevant.

bands.label: Secure
bands.descriptor: The response addresses the full task with a clear focus and mostly relevant, proportionate material.

bands.label: Strong
bands.descriptor: The response sustains a precise, thoughtful focus and uses every major part to fulfil the task.

criteria.title: Organisation and cohesion
criteria.description: How effectively the response orders ideas, develops paragraph purposes and makes relationships clear.

bands.label: Limited
bands.descriptor: Ideas are fragmented, unordered or difficult to follow.

bands.label: Emerging
bands.descriptor: Some order is visible, but paragraph purposes or connections are often unclear or mechanical.

bands.label: Developing
bands.descriptor: The response has a workable beginning, development and ending, with occasional abrupt or repetitive connections.

bands.label: Secure
bands.descriptor: Ideas are logically sequenced, paragraphs have clear purposes and connections usually support the meaning.

bands.label: Strong
bands.descriptor: The structure is purposeful and economical, with fluent connections that clarify development rather than merely decorate it.

criteria.title: Development and evidence
criteria.description: How specifically and credibly the response explains, illustrates or supports its central ideas.

bands.label: Limited
bands.descriptor: Claims or events are largely undeveloped, unsupported or implausibly broad.

bands.label: Emerging
bands.descriptor: The response includes a few details, but important claims, changes or lessons remain unexplained.

bands.label: Developing
bands.descriptor: Relevant examples or reasons support the main route, though some are generic, compressed or insufficiently connected.

bands.label: Secure
bands.descriptor: Specific, credible detail develops the main ideas and usually explains why the evidence matters.

bands.label: Strong
bands.descriptor: Well-chosen detail, explanation and qualification create convincing, insightful development throughout.

criteria.title: Language control and precision
criteria.description: How accurately and effectively vocabulary, sentences, grammar, spelling and punctuation communicate meaning.

bands.label: Limited
bands.descriptor: Frequent language errors or unclear choices repeatedly obstruct the intended meaning.

bands.label: Emerging
bands.descriptor: Meaning is sometimes clear, but recurring errors, vague wording or unstable sentences cause strain.

bands.label: Developing
bands.descriptor: Meaning is generally clear with adequate vocabulary and sentence control, despite noticeable recurring errors or repetition.

bands.label: Secure
bands.descriptor: Language is mostly accurate and precise, with controlled sentence variety and only minor lapses.

bands.label: Strong
bands.descriptor: Language is consistently precise, fluent and well controlled, with choices shaped to the purpose and register.

learner_disclaimer: This is a NextScholar instructional profile, not an official ASEAN Scholarship score or prediction.
